messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: HIGH severity: GPU pool 'eu-west-1-gpu-pool-2' approaching capacity. queue_length=12k, head_latency_p90=1.1s, throttled_requests=1.2k in last 5m. page: @Eli (oncall)
Eli (oncall): Acked. Looking. Are any deploys rolled out in the last hour?
Sara (eng-sre): I see an automated config rollout ~30m ago to runtime-config v3.14. It touched continuous_batch.window_ms and prefix_cache.warmup=true -> changed to false.
Jun (eng-runtime): Confirm. We rolled a batching tweak to shrink batch window from 40ms -> 12ms and disabled prefix warmup for perf microbench. That was supposed to reduce latency, not increase queue.
Maya (eng-ml): Quick note: shrinking batch window will reduce batch sizes for high-variance seq lengths. Also disabling prefix warmup increases prefix cache miss rate which can explode KV cache CPU and memory churn.
Eli (oncall): Pagerbot, escalate to P0 and notify customers if impact persists. Which models/routes are most affected?
ops-bot: Affected routes: /v1/generate (model: redwood-4x), /v1/chat (model: redwood-chat-4x). Top tenants by volume: tenant-alpha, tenant-gamma.
Sara (eng-sre): Autoscaler logs show desired=24, actual=12. Scale up attempts blocked by per-tenant instance cap for tenant-alpha (max_instances=12). Also several nodes failed readiness checks during rollout (docker image mismatch) so effective available=10.
Jun (eng-runtime): Here's the critical log snippet from autoscaler: ```
2024-09-12T18:22:31Z AUTOSCALER INFO desired_instances=24
2024-09-12T18:22:31Z AUTOSCALER WARN scaling_blocked=tenant_quota_limit tenant=tenant-alpha limit=12
2024-09-12T18:22:33Z NODE ERROR readiness_probe_failed node=gpu-aws-23 err="container crash"
```
Eli (oncall): So we have (1) config regression shrinking batch window + disabling prefix warmup -> throughput drop, (2) autoscaler trying to add but blocked by per-tenant caps and some nodes flapping.
Maya (eng-ml): Metric: prefix_cache_miss_rate jumped from 4% -> 68% after the change. Batch size median dropped from 10 -> 3 tokens per request. That directly explains token/s drop.
Sara (eng-sre): Immediate mitigations: 1) Roll back runtime-config v3.14 (re-enable prefix warmup + revert batch window). 2) Temporarily increase tenant-alpha max_instances quota to 30 for 45m. 3) Mark flaky nodes out of rotation and redeploy healthy nodes.
Jun (eng-runtime): I can initiate quick rollback for the config. Rolling back should be safe; it's config only. Doing: `/deploy runtime-config rollback v3.13`
ops-bot: Command accepted. Rollback job started: job_id=rb-20240912-17
Eli (oncall): While rollback is in flight, can we do a hot override to force autoscaler to ignore tenant caps (emergency override) so we can get headroom?
Sara (eng-sre): I can do a temporary override on the autoscaler: PATCH /internal/autoscaler/override {"force_instances":30, "ttl":2700}. Doing now.
Sara (eng-sre): Done. autoscaler.override.applied id=ovr-981 ttl=2700s.
Jun (eng-runtime): Noted. I'm also cordoning the 3 unhealthy nodes and spinning up replacements. `kubectl cordon gpu-aws-23 && kubectl create -f gpu-node-repl.yaml`
Maya (eng-ml): After the rollback started, I'm seeing prefix_cache_miss_rate trending down (68% -> 22%) and median batch size recovering (3 -> 8). Good sign.
Eli (oncall): Customer impact: ops-bot, please post short notice to status page and ping Customer Success for tenants above.
ops-bot: Status update posted: "Intermittent degraded throughput for generation endpoints in eu-west-1 starting 18:15 UTC. Working on mitigation. Potential throttling for heavy tenants." CS pinged for tenant-alpha and tenant-gamma.
Sara (eng-sre): After autoscaler override applied, new instances are provisioning. Desired=30 actual=22. Throttled_requests dropping from 1.2k -> 300 in last 5m.
Jun (eng-runtime): Rollback job rb-20240912-17 completed successfully. Runtime-config reverted to v3.13.
Maya (eng-ml): Post-rollback metrics: prefix_cache_miss_rate=6%, batch median=9, token/s per GPU increasing ~2.6x vs worst.
Eli (oncall): Reactions: :white_check_mark: Good. Keep autoscaler override for 30 more minutes while nodes stabilize; then we revert override and scale down gracefully.
Sara (eng-sre): Plan for post-incident: 1) Block the v3.14 rollout pending canary tests that include prefix_cache hit-rate check. 2) Add a safety gate to runtime-config that prevents batch_window_ms < 20ms for high-throughput pools. 3) Fix deployment failure that caused node readiness failures (image tag mismatch). 4) Add autoscaler alert that fires if scale_blocked_by_quota=true for >2m.
Jun (eng-runtime): I'll file a PR for the gating with a unit test and a canary harness change.
Maya (eng-ml): I'll prepare a short eval run to ensure batch window changes don't regress avg tokens/sec under realistic load.
Eli (oncall): Ops followups: revert autoscaler override (Sara) at 19:00 UTC if load normalizes; reduce tenant-alpha emergency quota afterwards. Also draft customer postmortem if customers reported errors.
Sara (eng-sre): Confirming current state: queue_length=1.2k, head_latency_p90=320ms, throttled_requests=80 last 5m. We'll keep monitoring.
ops-bot: Pager closed? No, still flagged as active.
Eli (oncall): Keep thread open for 2h for observation. Thanks team.
Sara (eng-sre): Incident ticket created: INC-2024-092-09. Slack thread pinned. Will collect logs/traces and attach to postmortem.
Maya (eng-ml): Note for postmortem: continuous_batch.window_ms interacts non-linearly with prefix cache design. Add simulation to our perf lab.
Jun (eng-runtime): Adding a runtime safety check to prevent disabling prefix warmup via fast rollout flags.
Eli (oncall): End of immediate actions. Thanks. :bow:
